title: Mauna Loa CO2
physical_mechanism: annual biosphere cycle over long-run anthropogenic increase
notes: paper physics case extended to 22-method real-data track

title: Global CH4
physical_mechanism: annual methane cycle over long-run atmospheric increase
notes: global greenhouse-gas analogue to Mauna Loa CO2

title: QBO 30mb
physical_mechanism: quasi-biennial oscillation in equatorial stratospheric zonal winds

title: Arctic Sea Ice Extent
physical_mechanism: strong annual melt-freeze cycle with long-run decline

title: Antarctic Sea Ice Extent
physical_mechanism: strong annual melt-freeze cycle with non-monotone long-run regime changes

title: Global NDVI
physical_mechanism: annual vegetation phenology with multi-decadal greening/browning structure
notes: reuses locally prepared global monthly mean NDVI

title: Sunspots Monthly
physical_mechanism: approximate 11-year solar cycle in monthly sunspot counts

title: Nino 3.4 SST Anomaly
physical_mechanism: ENSO variability with quasi-periodic 2-7 year warm/cool phases

title: SOI Monthly
physical_mechanism: Southern Oscillation pressure seesaw coupled to ENSO

title: PDO Index
physical_mechanism: Pacific decadal oscillation with multi-year to decadal structure

title: AO Index
physical_mechanism: Arctic Oscillation with strong seasonal modulation and low-frequency structure
notes: less periodic than core annual-cycle datasets

title: NAO Index
physical_mechanism: North Atlantic Oscillation with seasonally modulated low-frequency variability

title: Global Mean Sea Level
physical_mechanism: annual cycle superposed on secular sea-level rise

title: San Francisco Tide Hourly
physical_mechanism: semidiurnal and diurnal tidal constituents with known harmonic structure
notes: resampled from 6-minute NOAA CO-OPS observations to hourly means

title: New York Tide Hourly
physical_mechanism: mixed semidiurnal tide at NOAA CO-OPS station 8518750
notes: candidate tide station for future expansion

title: Honolulu Tide Hourly
physical_mechanism: mixed tide regime at NOAA CO-OPS station 1612340
notes: candidate tide station for future expansion

title: AMO Index
physical_mechanism: Atlantic multidecadal variability with long-period oscillatory structure
notes: official landing page found; direct csv export is awkward

title: Colorado River Streamflow
physical_mechanism: snowmelt-driven annual hydrograph with possible long-run trend shifts
notes: candidate hydrology series with clear annual forcing

title: IERS Length of Day
physical_mechanism: annual forcing plus Chandler-like geophysical wobble in Earth rotation diagnostics
notes: candidate geodesy benchmark needing dedicated parser
